_doc: The Bailiff Shield (Project Redmond R3, gadgets/R3_OPERATORS.md §2; Ulo's: the stun and the slow, set down, and the EMP shock that makes it hers): Bailiff's primary. A full-height plate held with her sidearm, as Hail's is (the sidearm fires aimed only): floor to over her head, wide, curving back round her sides, its top bent back over her (`plate.topWrap`), so none of her shows past it, feet included. Not aimed, a click of Fire switches its prod on and off (Ulo's): on, a jolt every `prod.everyS` into the first body of the other side within `prod.rangeM` and `prod.halfDeg` of the view (in sight): `prod.damage`, and slowed to `prod.slowMul` (no sprint, no vault) for `prod.slowS`; the prod runs on `prod.chargeS` of charge that refills at a second a second once it's been off `prod.refillDelayS`. Set down, its ability key switches the shield's own shock on and off (Ulo's): on, it jolts the nearest of the other side in front of it within `prod.rangeM` and `prod.postHalfDeg` the same way, on a charge of its own. The prod is electronic: an EMP on her turns it off for its seconds, and one reaching her while she holds the shield up shocks her: she can't move or use her hands for `prod.shockS`. Her ability item sets the shield down as standing cover where she faces (data/gadgets/bailiff_post.json), and she picks it up again (F). Its plate and every number of the prod are ours.
name: Bailiff Shield
